(men's) |[[1. FC Magdeburg (women)|Football
(women's)]] }}}} '''1. FC Magdeburg''' is a German [[association football]] [[Football club (association football)|club]] based in [[Magdeburg]]. The club was founded in 1965 from the football department of the [[Sports club (East Germany)|sports club]] ''[[SC Magdeburg]]'' and was one of the top teams in the East German [[DDR-Oberliga|Oberliga]], winning [[List of East German football champions|three championships]] and [[FDGB-Pokal|seven cup titles]]. By winning the [[European Cup Winners' Cup]] in [[1973–74 European Cup Winners' Cup|1974]], the club became the only East German club to win a European trophy and also achieved the greatest success in its history. After [[German reunification]], the club fell on hard times but returned to professional football in 2015 with the promotion to the [[3. Liga]]. Afterwards the team managed in 2018 to climb up to the [[2. Bundesliga|second division]], in which the team plays today."}}
